display_name: Read one managed session's ledger and host status
description: Returns the full managed_session ledger row for one agent_instance_id and adds honest native-host and permission-prompt observations. ledger_state repeats the durable lifecycle_state; host_liveness is alive, dead, or unknown; host_liveness_detail and host_liveness_observed_at identify the host observation; state_consistent is false only when the host is definitively dead while the ledger remains nonterminal. coordination_state is managed when dispatch_id is present, legacy_unsupervised for a nonterminal historical row without dispatch_id, and legacy_unmanaged for a terminal historical row without dispatch_id. permission_prompt_state is a read-only Claude tmux pane observation: blocked means a visible permission prompt, not_detected means a readable non-empty pane had no matching prompt, unknown means the host reference is missing or the pane observation is unavailable or empty, and not_applicable means another runtime or host. not_detected is not proof of safety. These observations do not change lifecycle state, approval, bypass, or permission policy. A missing host_ref, unavailable driver, or probe exception yields unknown rather than a false alive/dead claim.
embedding_description: agent_instance_id: ledger, host_liveness/detail/time, state_consistent, coordination; permission_prompt_state=blocked/not_detected/unknown/not_applicable. Claude tmux: blocked=visible; not_detected=no match in readable nonempty pane (not safety proof); unknown=missing host_ref/unavailable/empty. Other runtime/host=not_applicable. No lifecycle/approval/bypass/policy change.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: The full managed_session row plus ledger_state, host_liveness (alive, dead, or unknown), host_liveness_detail, host_liveness_observed_at, state_consistent, coordination_state (managed, legacy_unsupervised, or legacy_unmanaged), and read-only permission_prompt_state (blocked, not_detected, unknown, or not_applicable). For Claude tmux, blocked means a matching visible permission prompt; not_detected means a readable non-empty pane had no matching prompt and is not proof of safety; unknown covers a missing host reference or unavailable or empty pane observation. Other runtimes or hosts are not_applicable. The observation makes no lifecycle, approval, bypass, or permission-policy change.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with ledger_state and host_liveness, preserving unknown as unknown. Call out state_consistent=false as a measured ledger/host conflict. Present permission_prompt_state as a read-only observation: preserve unknown as unknown, describe not_detected as absence of a matching prompt in a readable non-empty pane rather than proof of safety, and retain not_applicable for other runtimes or hosts. Do not imply a lifecycle transition or approval, bypass, or permission-policy change. Use lane_id and unit_id for orientation, and note report_by only when close or overdue.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: A single filtered managed_session read followed by a best-effort native host-driver liveness probe.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: session_not_found: no managed_session row exists for the given agent_instance_id (never claimed, or hard-deleted). state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound. Host-driver resolution and probe failures do not fail the read; they return host_liveness=unknown with diagnostic detail.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For session_not_found, confirm the agent_instance_id via list_sessions or the caller's own spawn_session result rather than retrying the same id.
